document_title: ALLEY KINGS — SQUAD-BASED MMO SYSTEM UPDATE
update_type: MAJOR FEATURE ADDITION — Squad-Based Overworld & Cooperative Combat

executive_summary.problem_identified: Current design treats building entry as solo experience. Player wants squad-based overworld movement, multi-deck cooperative battles, and mini-teams within crew specializing in different game modes.
executive_summary.solution: Implement SQUAD SYSTEM — players form 2-5 person squads within their crew, move together on overworld map, enter buildings/fights as a unit, combine decks for cooperative combat, with major crew events aggregating all squad performance into total crew score.
research_basis: World of Warcraft raid composition (tank/healer/DPS trinity, 2-4-14 ratio in 20-player raids)
League of Legends team comp dynamics (engage/peel/siege compositions)
Call of Duty squad mechanics (squad spawning, shared objectives)
MMORPG party systems (open world cooperative, shared loot)
Clash of Clans clan games (multiple events, total points aggregation)
executive_summary.key_principle: Every player has a MAIN ROLE but can flex. Crews form SQUADS based on role composition. Squads move as PACKS on the overworld. Buildings scale to squad size. Major crew events aggregate ALL squad performance.

the_squad_system.overview: Within every crew, players form SQUADS of 2-5 members. Squads are persistent (not temporary parties) with shared history, shared loot records, and shared reputation. A crew can have multiple squads. Players can be in only one squad at a time but can switch with 24h cooldown.

formation_rules: Members must be in same crew
Members must be within 100 pixels on overworld map
Squad name chosen by leader (must be crew-appropriate)
Squad emblem auto-generated from crew emblem + squad color accent

squad_roles.description: Each player brings their MAIN ROLE to the squad. Roles are determined by their highest-level card archetype, NOT chosen at squad formation.

VANGUARD.function: Absorbs damage, draws enemy attention, protects squad
VANGUARD.deck_contribution: High health cards, taunt abilities, shield spells
VANGUARD.visual_indicator: Red aura outline, shield icon above head
VANGUARD.squad_benefit: Allies behind Vanguard take 25% less damage

MENDER.function: Restores squad health, removes debuffs, revives fallen allies
MENDER.deck_contribution: Heal spells, cleanse abilities, resurrection cards
MENDER.visual_indicator: Green aura outline, cross icon above head
MENDER.squad_benefit: Squad regenerates 5% health every 10 seconds while Mender is alive

STRIKER.function: Deals high damage at close range, executes low-health enemies
STRIKER.deck_contribution: High attack cards, critical hit abilities, execute spells
STRIKER.visual_indicator: Orange aura outline, sword icon above head
STRIKER.squad_benefit: Vanguard's taunt duration increased by 2 seconds per Striker

SNIPER.function: Deals damage from distance, targets enemy backline, applies debuffs
SNIPER.deck_contribution: Ranged attack cards, poison/curse abilities, mark spells
SNIPER.visual_indicator: Purple aura outline, crosshair icon above head
SNIPER.squad_benefit: Enemy healing reduced by 15% per Sniper in squad

TACTICIAN.function: Buffs allies, debuffs enemies, controls battlefield, draws cards
TACTICIAN.deck_contribution: Buff spells, crowd control, card draw abilities, trap cards
TACTICIAN.visual_indicator: Blue aura outline, chess piece icon above head
TACTICIAN.squad_benefit: All squad members draw +1 card at battle start per Tactician

optimal_compositions.description: Based on WoW raid composition research (2 tanks, 4-5 healers, 10-14 DPS in 20-player raids) adapted to 5-person squads

2_person_squad.risk: No flexibility if one role is countered

3_person_squad.note: 3-person is the SWEET SPOT for most content

5_person_squad.recommended: 1 Vanguard + 1 Mender + 1 Striker + 1 Sniper + 1 Tactician (full composition)
5_person_squad.note: Maximum power but harder to coordinate

squad_overworld_movement.description: When squad is formed, members move together on the overworld map as a PACK. Like League of Legends team movement or Call of Duty squad spawning.

movement_mechanics.pack_formation: Squad members auto-arrange in diamond formation around leader. Leader controls movement. Others follow.
movement_mechanics.follow_distance: Members maintain 20-30 pixel distance from leader. If lagging, auto-sprint to catch up.
movement_mechanics.visual_representation: Squad shown as connected group with colored lines between members. Leader has crown icon. Role icons visible above each member.
movement_mechanics.camera_behavior: Camera centers on squad center-of-mass. Zooms out slightly for larger squads.

entering_buildings.description: When squad approaches building, ALL members must confirm entry. Majority vote = squad enters together.
entering_buildings.solo_option: Player can choose 'Enter Solo' to break from squad temporarily. Rejoins on exit.
entering_buildings.building_scaling: Building interior scales to squad size. Enemy count, health, and loot all scale.

encountering_enemies.description: When squad encounters enemy squad or NPCs on overworld, both parties enter COMBAT ZONE.
encountering_enemies.combat_zone: Circular arena spawns around encounter point. Non-participants can watch but not interfere.
encountering_enemies.escape_option: Squad can attempt retreat. Success = all members escape. Failure = combat continues.
encountering_enemies.ambush_mechanic: Sniper-class players can initiate ambush from stealth, giving squad first-turn advantage.

resource_gathering.description: Squad gathering = faster collection. Each member contributes to gathering speed.
resource_gathering.scrap_yard: 5-person squad gathers 3x faster than solo. Shared pool, distributed by squad settings.

squad_emotes_and_communication.squad_only_chat: Private squad channel, separate from crew chat. Visible only to squad members.
squad_emotes_and_communication.quick_pings: Leader can ping locations (move here, attack this, retreat, loot here).
squad_emotes_and_communication.squad_emotes: Synchronized emotes when squad is together. 'Squad Pose' for screenshots.
squad_emotes_and_communication.voice_chat: Proximity voice chat within squad. 300% adoption increase in 2025 makes this critical.

multi_deck_cooperative_combat.description: When squad enters combat, ALL members' decks combine into a SHARED BATTLE POOL. This is the core innovation — not 1v1 card battles, but squad vs squad or squad vs boss with combined card pools.

battle_pool_system.pool_size: Squad of 5 = up to 150 cards in pool (30 per player max). Actual pool = all equipped cards.
battle_pool_system.shared_hand: Squad shares a SINGLE HAND of cards drawn from the pool. Hand size = 5 + (1 per Tactician in squad).

turn_structure.description: Squad takes turns as a UNIT, not individually.
turn_structure.squad_turn: Squad leader decides which card from shared hand to play. Can consult squad via quick chat.
turn_structure.card_attribution: Card shows which player's deck it came from. That player gets XP for card use.

role_bonuses.Vanguard_cards: When Vanguard plays their own card, taunt effect duration +50%
role_bonuses.Mender_cards: When Mender plays their own card, heal amount +50%
role_bonuses.Striker_cards: When Striker plays their own card, critical chance +25%
role_bonuses.Sniper_cards: When Sniper plays their own card, range +1 and ignores shields
role_bonuses.Tactician_cards: When Tactician plays their own card, draw 1 additional card

combo_system.description: Playing cards from same player in sequence creates COMBOS. Playing cards from different players creates SYNERGY.
combo_system.combos: 3+ cards from same player in a row = combo multiplier on damage/healing
combo_system.synergy: Cards from 3+ different players in a row = synergy effect (random buff to entire squad)
combo_system.role_chain: Vanguard → Mender → Striker → Sniper → Tactician = perfect role chain, massive bonus

enemy_scaling.squad_vs_squad: Enemy squad has same composition rules. Matchmaking pairs squads of similar total deck power.

squad_vs_boss.description: World bosses and clan mission bosses scale to squad size and composition.
squad_vs_boss.health_scaling: Boss health = base × (1 + 0.5 per squad member). 5-person = 3.5x health.
squad_vs_boss.mechanic_scaling: Boss gains new mechanics at 3-person and 5-person thresholds.
squad_vs_boss.loot_scaling: Loot quantity = base × squad size. Loot quality = base + (0.1 per squad member).
squad_vs_boss.shared_loot: All squad members get loot. No fighting over drops. Like WoW personal loot system.

squad_formation_tactics.description: During combat, squad can arrange into FORMATIONS that provide passive bonuses.

PHALANX.bonus: Vanguard takes 50% more damage but allies take 50% less

WEDGE.arrangement: Vanguard point, Strikers flanking, Mender/Sniper/Tactician rear

CIRCLE.bonus: No backline. All members can target any enemy. +10% healing received.

SKIRMISH.bonus: Area attacks hit only 1 member. Sniper range +2.

BLOB.bonus: Mender heals affect all members. Area buffs affect all. But area enemy attacks hit all.

mini_teams_within_crew.description: Crews naturally form MINI-TEAMS based on player preferences and strengths. These are NOT formal subgroups but emergent specializations.

TOWER_BATTERS.description: Players who excel at 1v1 tower battles
TOWER_BATTERS.focus: Card deck optimization, meta knowledge, quick decision-making
TOWER_BATTERS.crew_contribution: Win tower battles = crew reputation points
TOWER_BATTERS.mini_team_events: Tower Battle Tournaments — 1v1 bracket within crew, winner represents crew in inter-crew tournaments
TOWER_BATTERS.recognition: Tower Champion title, special card frame, leaderboard on crew hall wall

RAID_SPECIALISTS.description: Players who excel at cooperative clan missions and boss fights
RAID_SPECIALISTS.focus: Role mastery, coordination, boss mechanic knowledge
RAID_SPECIALISTS.crew_contribution: Complete clan missions = crew resource income
RAID_SPECIALISTS.mini_team_events: Speedrun Challenges — fastest clan mission completion times
RAID_SPECIALISTS.recognition: Raid Legend title, special gear appearance, trophy in crew hall

TERRITORY_WARRIORS.description: Players who excel at District vs District and crew war events
TERRITORY_WARRIORS.focus: Large-scale strategy, territory control, siege tactics
TERRITORY_WARRIORS.crew_contribution: Win wars = crew territory and daily income
TERRITORY_WARRIORS.mini_team_events: War Council — strategic planning for upcoming DvD events
TERRITORY_WARRIORS.recognition: War Hero title, territory naming rights, statue in controlled district

ECONOMISTS.description: Players who excel at marketplace trading and resource management
ECONOMISTS.mini_team_events: Trading Competitions — most profit in set time
ECONOMISTS.recognition: Market Mogul title, exclusive shop skin, economic advisor role

SOCIAL_CONNECTORS.description: Players who excel at recruitment, diplomacy, and crew culture
SOCIAL_CONNECTORS.focus: Social skills, event organization, conflict resolution
SOCIAL_CONNECTORS.mini_team_events: Crew Culture Awards — best event, best meme, most helpful member
SOCIAL_CONNECTORS.recognition: Heart of the Crew title, custom emote, hall of fame portrait

cross_specialization_benefits.description: Specializations are NOT silos. They feed into each other.
cross_specialization_benefits.tower_batters_support_raid: Tower battle winnings fund raid consumables
cross_specialization_benefits.economists_support_social: Treasury funds crew events and rewards

major_crew_events.description: Periodic events where ALL squad performance aggregates into TOTAL CREW SCORE. These are the climaxes of crew activity.

CREW_GAMES.description: Multiple mini-events running simultaneously. Each squad chooses which to participate in.
events: Tower Battle Marathon — most tower battle wins
Raid Rush — most clan missions completed
Territory Takedown — most enemy buildings raided
Economic Empire — most $ALK earned through trading
Social Surge — most new recruits and active members
CREW_GAMES.scoring: Each mini-event awards points 1st-10th place. Total crew score = sum of all mini-event points.

rewards.crew_rewards: Crew chest tier based on total score, crew-wide buffs, territory upgrades
rewards.squad_rewards: Squad-specific rewards based on which events they participated in
rewards.individual_rewards: Personal rewards based on individual contribution to squad performance

CREW_GAMES.clash_of_clans_reference: Inspired by Clan Games — multiple events, total points, tiered rewards

CREW_WAR_SEASON.description: Month-long war season with multiple phases.

phases.WEEK_1_RECON: Squads scout enemy territories, gather intel, plan attacks
phases.WEEK_2_SKIRMISH: Small-scale squad vs squad battles for border territories
phases.WEEK_3_SIEGE: Large-scale crew vs crew battles for major territories
phases.WEEK_4_FINALS: Championship battles, territory consolidation, victory celebrations

CREW_WAR_SEASON.scoring: Territory control = daily points. Successful raids = bonus points. Defensive holds = bonus points.

rewards.season_winner: Crew name carved on server monument, exclusive skin set, $ALK prize pool
rewards.top_squads: Squad-specific rewards, squad hall upgrades, custom squad emblems
rewards.participation: All participants get season chest with rewards scaled to contribution

DISTRICT_VS_DISTRICT_CHAMPIONSHIP.description: Server-wide event. Two districts matched by power. All crews in district fight together.
DISTRICT_VS_DISTRICT_CHAMPIONSHIP.squad_role: Squads are the BASIC UNIT of DvD. Crews assign squads to different objectives.
objectives: Central Tower Assault — squads fight to capture and hold
Supply Line Disruption — squads raid enemy supply routes
Defensive Perimeter — squads defend friendly positions
Intel Gathering — squads scout and report enemy movements
DISTRICT_VS_DISTRICT_CHAMPIONSHIP.scoring: Objective points + kill points + survival points = squad score. Squad scores aggregate to crew score. Crew scores aggregate to district score.

rewards.winning_district: District-wide buffs for 2 weeks, exclusive district skin, bragging rights
rewards.top_crews: Crew rewards based on district contribution ranking
rewards.top_squads: Squad rewards, squad name on district memorial
rewards.individual: Personal rewards based on squad performance and individual contribution

THE_GAUNTLET.description: Survival challenge. Squads face increasingly difficult waves of enemies.
THE_GAUNTLET.mechanics: Waves 1-10 = basic enemies. Waves 11-20 = elite enemies. Waves 21+ = boss enemies. Each wave harder than last.
THE_GAUNTLET.scoring: Highest wave reached × squad size modifier × role diversity bonus = squad score
THE_GAUNTLET.squad_strategy: Squad composition CRITICAL. Need sustain (Mender), damage (Striker/Sniper), and crowd control (Tactician) for high waves.
THE_GAUNTLET.rewards: Wave milestones = instant rewards. Weekly leaderboard = bonus rewards. Server record = permanent recognition.

CREW_ASCENSION_CEREMONY.description: When crew ascends to next tier, entire crew participates in ceremony.
CREW_ASCENSION_CEREMONY.mechanics: All squads must complete a cooperative challenge. Success = ascension proceeds. Failure = can retry after 24h.
challenge_types: Tower Defense — defend Main Tower against waves
Relay Race — squads pass baton through obstacle course
Boss Rush — defeat series of bosses in sequence
Puzzle Gauntlet — solve cooperative puzzles under time pressure
CREW_ASCENSION_CEREMONY.rewards: Ascension tier unlock, visual upgrade for all buildings, crew-wide buff, celebration event

total_points_aggregation.description: Every action by every squad member contributes to TOTAL CREW SCORE.

point_sources.daily_activities: Tower battles, resource gathering, mini-games = small daily points
point_sources.squad_achievements: Squad milestones (first 100 wins, perfect run, etc.) = medium points
point_sources.crew_events: Crew Games, War Season, DvD = large points
point_sources.special_achievements: Server firsts, world records, community recognition = massive points

leaderboards.squad_leaderboard: Within crew, squads ranked by total contribution
leaderboards.crew_leaderboard: Server-wide, crews ranked by total score
leaderboards.district_leaderboard: Districts ranked by aggregate crew scores
leaderboards.individual_leaderboard: Players ranked by total contribution across all activities

total_points_aggregation.visual_representation: Crew hall has LIVE SCOREBOARD showing real-time crew ranking, squad contributions, and progress toward next event tier.

networking.authority: Server authoritative for combat, client authoritative for movement (with server validation)

matchmaking.squad_vs_boss: Scale boss to squad composition (more DPS = more boss health, more healers = more boss damage)

critical_reminders_for_next_agent: SQUAD SYSTEM is not an add-on. It is CORE to the game experience. Every system must account for squad play.
Building entry is NOT solo. Squads enter together. Buildings scale to squad size.
Combat is NOT 1v1. It is squad vs squad or squad vs boss with SHARED DECK POOL.
Role system (Vanguard/Mender/Striker/Sniper/Tactician) is DERIVED from player card archetypes, NOT chosen separately.
Mini-teams within crew are EMERGENT, not forced. Players naturally specialize.
Major crew events aggregate ALL squad performance. No squad is irrelevant.
Art must show squad visual identity — connected members, role auras, formation silhouettes.
UI must support shared hand, pool composition, combo tracking, and formation selection.
Voice chat is ESSENTIAL for squad coordination. Proximity voice within squad.
Squad persistence creates SOCIAL BONDS. Switching squads has 24h cooldown to prevent abuse.
Loot is SHARED in squad combat. No fighting over drops. Everyone gets rewards.
Enemy scaling ensures squads of all sizes find appropriate challenge.
The client's vision is MMO-like social experience, not solo card game with chat.
